Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Puppet] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP until their turn ends for each of your Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon are deleted, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.
